prompt:
Fix snippets/engraving-availability.liquid so it renders the engraving option block for a product exactly as specified. Inputs (all top-level variables; there is no section object): - product_title: string, never null. - engraving: object or null. When it is not null it always has all four keys: - engraving.enabled: boolean. - engraving.max_chars: integer or null. - engraving.fonts: array of strings (may be empty). - engraving.note: string or null. Output rules. Do not output any whitespace or newlines before, after or between elements. All text interpolated from inputs (product_title, each font, the note) must be HTML-escaped with the escape filter. 1. If engraving is null, or engraving.enabled is not true, output only:

Engraving is not available for TITLE

where TITLE is the escaped product_title. 2. Otherwise output a
wrapper that contains, in this order: a. Always:

Engrave your TITLE

b. Only if max_chars is not null and greater than 0:

Up to N characters

where N is max_chars; use the singular word "character" when N is exactly 1 ("Up to 1 character"). c. Only if fonts contains at least one entry:
    containing one
  • FONT
    • per font in array order. If fonts is empty, the
      must not be output at all. d. Only if the note, after stripping leading/trailing whitespace, is non-empty (null counts as empty):

      NOTE

      with the stripped, escaped note. Then close
. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/engraving-availability.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
